metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at a wall and Valorant said ‘Go ahead, take it’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get gifted a kill? Enemy probably paused to rethink life. Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still hands out freebies!

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
